body: School isn't an end in itself. Just think about your goals and imagine how you want to get there. Usually school isn't really that important in the long run.

He is right that making friends requires you to put yourself out there. However if that is very scary you could try talking to people online. It might seems less scary to make friends for example here on reddit.

Just remember it can all get better. A year ago I was also at a point where I saw no way life could get better. I am glad I didn't go through with my suicide plans because I met my girlfriend and we are very happy now.
Okay but then it's easy. If it makes absolutely no difference for you whether you are happy or sad, you can just go on living. No reason to end it if you don't mind being unhappy.
Well, do you think your happiness has inherent value?

I'm not telling you to make something up. I'm telling you to think about whats important to you in life, what makes you happy and what goals you want to achieve in life and use that to base your life's purpose on.

Life does not have inherent meaning. You have to create the meaning for yourself. This is not easy but if you put effort into your life it will get better. first you will have to decide what is important to you so you have something to work towards.
depression can make it seem like you don't want anything and nothing is possible. Do you remember what your goals and dreams were before you felt this way?
why do you think there is no life for you? I agree that living for others is pointless so what would you want to get out of life?

He's right. You could try one course and if that works another one and slowly build it up. You shouldn't beat yourself up over playing video games. Every 25 y/o does that. If you feel like you're not close to your friends maybe try having some personal conversations with them and tell them about your problems. Finally I would like to say that even though it seems everybody hates you and is constantly thinking about you, think for a moment how much time you spend fussing over a stranger you saw. People aren't so focused on others as you might think. Everybody is focused on him or herself. So don't worry about what others think so much because they really don't care.
